Ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes kirikugamba ngu ekintu ekiri omu maizi kirimu oburemeezi oburikukwata aha bwomeezi bw'amaizi oburikurugamu (buoyant force). Omumanyiso oguremesa omumanya gw'ekyo ni:

**C**

Omumanyiso oguteekateeka ngu oburemeezi oburikukora aha mubiri oguri omu maizi nibyesigamira aha bwomeezi obu gurimu - eki kiremesa omumanya gw'ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes, kuba ekigyendererwa kirikugamba ngu oburemeezi burikukwata aha bwomeezi bw'amaizi oburikurugamu (oburikutwara ekifo ky'ekintu), tari aha bwomeezi bw'ekintu kyenka.

**C**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa: "Shoboorora ebintu ebitari bimwe ebirikubaho buri izooba orikukoresa omusingi gwa Bernoulli."

Omusingi gwa Bernoulli gukwatiraine n'engufu y'amazzi/omuyaga agari omu kugaruka - ahari omuyaga/amazzi garikugaruka obusingire, omushushano gurikuragura.

Ninkwetegyereza ebigaruzo:

A. Kushoborora emigararuro etari emwe - Eki ni kirungi, abegi nibashobora kushoborora emigararuro emirikukurataho omusingi gwa Bernoulli.

B. Akamashine akakozesibwa okushuukira ebihogo - Eki tikiri kukurataho omusingi gwa Bernoulli.

C. Kushoborora ahabw'enki obureingwa bw'omugongo gw'amaizi bugyezibwa obu buri kugwa kuruga omu taapu - Eki kikurataho omusingi gwa Bernoulli: amazzi agarikugaruka obusingire garikureeta omushushano oguragura (obureingwa).

D. Kushoborora ahabw'enki ecupa ya pulasitiki eremwa obu omuyaga oguri omunda gwayotsibwe - Eki tikiri kukurataho omusingi gwa Bernoulli, kikurataho omushushano gw'omuyaga.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisinga kureetera omwegyesa kumanya ngu abegi bahikiire aha kigyendererwa ni **C** - ahabw'okuba nibashobora kushoborora ekikwatagurizo ekiri omu buri izooba (amaizi agarikugaruka omu taapu) orikukoresa omusingi gwa Bernoulli.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ari kukora ekizibu ky'okuhandiika okucungura ekitongole ky'okutegyereza ebikwatiraine n'okutegyereza okurikwinga. Ekigambo kikuru ni "Nibakoresa emigararo y'ekibaro erikushoborora omuringo gw'okutegyereza ogurikwinga ogutahinduka kushobora oburemeezi obutari bumwe."

Ekigambo ekikuru hano ni:
- Emigararo y'ekibaro (formulas matemáticas)
- Omuringo gw'okutegyereza ogurikwinga (movimiento circular)
- Oburemeezi obutari bumwe (diferentes contextos)

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Okuzunguruka kw'ekirima - Eki kirikukurata omuringo gw'okuzunguruka, nari tikiri kukurata emigararo y'ekibaro erikushoborora.

B. Omutabo n'omwinganiso - Eki kirikukurata emigararo (angle en radianes), nari tikiri kukurata oburemeezi obutari bumwe.

C. Obwangu bw'akameme - Eki kirikukurata emigararo y'ekibaro (obwangu oburikwingana) omu buremeezi obutari bumwe (oburaayo obutari bumwe: R na R/2).

D. Emigararo y'okubara omushoberera - Eki kirikurata emigararo (v = rω), nari tikiri kukurata oburemeezi obutari bumwe omu kibuuzo.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukiraho ni **C** - kirikukurata emigararo y'ekibaro omu buremeezi obutari bumwe.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akwenda abegyeswa bahikane eky'okuhinduka okurikukora omu bwiini bw'obutini obw'emishisa n'obumanzi bwabwo.

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

A. Kworeka emitwarize y'ebintu ebirikurugwa omu kintu ekiriyo nikyeyenda omu mucwe gw'obutareeba
B. Kushoboorora omutaano gw'ebintu ebirikurugamu omu kashushani k'omukanda gw'obumanzi bw'enkyerere
C. Kucuunda aha maani g'okureebana n'okukwatana agari omunda y'akacwe kamatomu
D. Kwetegekereza akameeza akarikukwata aha miringo y'okubumbuka kw'ebintu

Ekigyendererwa ni "okuhinduka okurikukora omu bwiini bw'obutini obw'emishisa n'obumanzi." Kino kirikugamba aha nkora y'okuhinduka kw'ebintu (phase changes) - okushushana, okukoma, okubumbuka.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikusingira kuhikana ekigyendererwa eki ni **D** - kwetegekereza akameeza akarikukwata aha miringo y'okubumbuka kw'ebintu, kuba kino nikyeyongera aha nkora y'okuhinduka kw'ebintu omu bwiini bw'emishisa n'obumanzi.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa yegyesa aha mutwe gw'ekicweka ky'obutaguruka bw'ebintu (Chemical Equilibrium), n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirikukorwa omu kwegaita kw'ebintu. Akoresa kashushani akarikworeka obunji bw'ekintu n'obwire.

Ekibuuzo kirikubuuza: Mubuzo ki omwegyesa orikubaasa kubuuza kubaasa kuhwera abegyegyi kwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu omu kwegaita kw'ebintu kuraba omu kushoborora ekishushani?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Ahabweire ki ekirikuruga omu by'okubanza n'ebirikurugamu aha guraafu? - Ekibuuzo eki kirikubuuza aha by'okubanza n'ebirikurugamu, kyonka tikihikire aha kuhinduka kw'obunji.

B. Obungi ki bw'amaanyi g'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebyo ebivaamu obukozesi bwabyo obutandika? - Ekibuuzo eki kirikubuuza aha bunji bw'amaanyi obutandika, kyonka tikihikire aha kuhinduka.

C. Eizo kiro kiro eby'okubangaanisa birekeraaho kugwaawo kandi n'ebirikurugamu birekeraaho kukorwa? - Ekibuuzo eki kirikubuuza aha kiro kiro eby'okubangaanisa, kyonka tikihikire aha kuhinduka kw'obunji.

D. Harimu oburemeezi omu kubumbwa n'okukozesebwa kw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirikurugamu? - Ekibuuzo eki kirikubuuza aha buremeezi, ekihikire aha kuhinduka kw'obunji bw'ebintu.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omugyezibwa areeba ngu abeeshumi batunga omuhendo gwa pH oguri ahansi y'efuuru bwanyima y'akashusho ka titration. Ekibuuzo nikigamba ngu ni murimo ki ogurikukurataho oguraagira omugyezibwa kugarura abeeshumi kumariiriza okuzooka ekikoomi ky'okuringaaniza?

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Yenda abeshomesa omu maabaraato - Eki tikiri solution y'okumanya ekizibu

B. Mugambe ngu kipimo kya pH kikyombekirwe kurugiirira aha muhendo murungi gw'obwingi - Eki nikigamba ngu basobore kumanya omumaiso gw'okulingaaniza

C. Mubagambire oku murikubaasa kushoboorora omuhendo gw'emooli + eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka enkora y'okubara emooli omu bitaano ebitari bimwe by'okutitrate

D. Koresa kompyuta omwegyesibwa arikuta omuhendo - Eki nikigamba ngu bakozese technology

Eky'okureeberaho ekirikuweebwa omu C nikireeta enkora ey'okubara emooli za HCl n'emooli za NaOH omu bitaano ebitari bimwe by'okutitrate, ekirikworeka engeri y'okumanya omumaiso gw'okulingaaniza.

Eky'okugarukamu:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa owa sekenda ari kukora aha mugasho gw'okwegyesa "Kushoborora embeera y'okuringaniza erikuhikwaho enyikirizo z'eby'omwiisho" omu kiraasi erikukwatanisa n'omutwe gw'okuringaniza kw'eby'omwiisho.

Abegyeswa barikumubuuza: "Ebirikutwarwa n'ebirikurugamu nibihika aha mbeera y'okuringaniza omu bwabo?"

Ekibuuzo eki kirikworeka ngu abegyeswa barikwetegereza aha nkora y'okuringaniza kw'eby'omwiisho - harimu ebirikutwarwa (reactants) n'ebirikurugamu (products) omu nkora y'eby'omwiisho.

Omuringo ogusingire omu kwegyesa-okwega ogukwatiraine n'ekibuuzo eki ni:

**C** - Kora omukoro gw'okugezesa ogurikworeka ebi ebiriho ebirikuhindura embeera y'oburingaaniza omu nkora z'ebintu bya kemikali.

Ekyo nikireeta abegyeswa kwega omu buryo bw'okugezesa n'okureeba ebi ebiriho ebirikuhindura embeera y'okuringaniza, ekibakwasa okwetegereza aha nkora y'eby'omwiisho omu buryo obw'okukora.

**C**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa arikubaasa kubuuza ekibuuzo ki ekirikureetera abegyesa kuta omutima aha biteekateeko byabo kuruga omu kumanyisa oku?

Ninkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A. Ekibuuzo ky'obushushu n'entebeekanisa - kiri kyongyera technical
B. Ekibuuzo ky'okurugyererana - kiri kyongyera general
C. Ekibuuzo ekirikubaza AHABW'ENKI n'ekirikubaza abegyesa KUGAMBA aha bintu ebirikukara n'ebirikuhoora - eki kireetera abegyesa kwetegyereza n'okwegayirira ebyabaire bamazire
D. Ekibuuzo ky'omubumbo - kiri technical

Ekibuuzo C nikirikureetera abegyesa:
- Kwetegyereza obumanyire bwabo (metacognition)
- Kugamba/kwegayirira ebyabaire bamazire
- Kuta omutima aha biteekateeko byabo

**C**

Nkuteekateeka ekibuuzo:

Abanyeshuri b'omu mwaka ogw'okushatu omu mashomero ga sekenda nibetebeekanisa lipooti y'ekicweka aha kucweera ekirikwetwa "Ebintu Ebirikukwata aha Muhendo gw'Ekyetengo." Ni by'endaaba ki ebi baraabe bamaze kwega kubaasa kushoboorora ebirugiremu ebi baatoonire?

Ekibuuzo kiri kukwata aha bintu ebirikukwata aha **muhendo gw'ekyetengo** (ciclo de vida). Omu kucweera kw'ebintu ebirikukwata aha muhendo gw'ekyetengo, abanyeshuri nibega aha:
- Emigenzo y'okuhinduka ogurikubaho omu bwire bw'obuzima bw'ekintu
- Entambura ez'enjawulo omu muhendo (okubonwa, okukura, okukuza, okupfa)
- Ebintu ebirikuhinduka omu buri ntambura

Eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine n'okwega kw'emigenzo y'okuhinduka omu muhendo gw'obuzima nikyo:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa abuuza abegyesi kutunga omurimo ogurikukurataho:
- Handiika engyenderwaho y'abarastani yona ey'ebintu ebiri omunshonga y'amaizi (H₂O) na amonia (NH₃)
- Shushani emishushani ya Lewis erikuhikaana na buli nshonga
- Yombeka emishushani y'enshonga zoona n'ebumba n'obuti bw'emichwe nk'oku biri omu muringo gwazo
- Shaho okushushana n'okutashushana aha miringo y'enshonga zombi

Omurimo ogu gurikukurataho:
- Okwandiika abarastani (H, O, N)
- Okushushana emishushani ya Lewis (ebipooli by'amasannyalaze)
- Okuyombeka emishushani y'enshonga (geometrical structure)
- Okugereranya emiringo y'enshonga zombi

Eki kyoona kirikukurataho **omuringo gw'okwegomba kw'amasannyalaze g'omu kabindo k'aha rubaju (VSEPR theory)** - ogurikushuuruura engeri enshonga ezikora emishushani yazo kurugiirira aha kugabana kw'ebipooli by'amasannyalaze (bonding n'ebiri lone pairs).

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa omukuru ayenda abegyesi be kwetegyereza ebintu ebikuru ebiri omu kubara obwire bw'ekintu ekirimu obutwa obwa radioactive (half-life).

Nkwetegyereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Shuuruuraana omu mwirondoozi - Eki nikireeta okushuuruuraana omu mwirondoozi, tikireeta kubara obwire bw'ekintu.

B. Ndyemeza ngu obwingi bw'akanya akarikukira... nikigwa - Eki nikireeta okwetegyereza enkoragana hagati y'obwingi bw'akanya n'obwingi bw'ebintu, ekikwatiraine n'ekiikaro bw'ekintu (half-life concept).

C. Kuhuumuriza ebiri omu meza y'ebiro - Eki nikireeta okuhuurira amakuru omu meza, tikireeta kubara obwire.

D. Teerera okuhinduka kw'ekintu - Eki nikireeta okuteerera okuhinduka, tikireeta kubara obwire bw'ekintu.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **B** - kuba nikireeta abegyesi kwetegyereza enkoragana hagati y'obwingi bw'akanya n'obwingi bw'ebintu ebiriyo, ekikwatiraine n'ekiikaro bw'ekintu ekirimu obutwa obwa radioactive.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi w'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu ishomero erikuru aine kucungura okwetegyereza kw'abegyeshwa aha bukuru bw'ebirikurugamu omu muringo ogurikuroraanisa omu kubaririra kw'ebirikurungo.

Ekibuuzo nikibaza: Ni bintu ki ebi omwegyesi arikubaasa kutebeekanisiza abegyeshwa kureetera kumanya ngu bamanyire ebi baayegire?

Nkwetegereza ebyokugarukamu:

A. Bara omuhendo gw'omugano gw'ebipimo bya mole - Eki nikireeba aha mole (mass), tikiri aha bukuru bw'ebirikurugamu

B. Bariita obureme bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirugamu, oteekateeke omukago gwabyo omu kubara - Eki nikireeba aha obureme n'omukago, tikiri aha bukuru bw'ebirikurugamu

C. Yombeka omugamba gw'okuhinduranya hagati y'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebintu ebireetwawo, n'omutindo gwabyo ogw'obwingi omu kikumi - Eki nikireeba aha mutindo gw'obwingi (percentage composition), tikiri aha bukuru bw'ebirikurugamu

D. Yombeka omumeza gw'okuhikaanisa hagati y'emoola, obutini, n'obucweka bw'akatomu - Eki nikireeba aha kuhikaanisa ebipimo by'akatomu (moles, mass, volume), ekirikukurataho aha bukuru bw'ebirikurugamu omu muringo

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'eky'okuna arikuyenda kureetera abeeshuri obwengye bw'okutebeekanisa ebintu omu mbeera z'ebintu.

Nkureeba eky'okugarukamu kyona:

**A.** Omulingo gw'okukora okucweeka - okworeka ngu oburemu bw'ekintu tibuhinduka eki kiyemeire (kino ni principle of conservation of mass/matter)

**B.** Kuhandiika n'okushuura omuringo - kumanya yaaba amaizi gahinduka obwingi obu gahinduka embeera (kino nikureeba aha states of matter)

**C.** Kukoresa ekipima bwihotero - kureeba obwiihotero bw'amaizi obu buhinduka (kino nikureeba aha temperature changes)

**D.** Okushuururwa kw'amaizi omu bwihumbi (kino nikureeba aha evaporation)

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha **"okutebeekanisa ebintu"** - kino nikugamba aha classifying/categorizing properties of matter.

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikireeta obwengye bw'okutebeekanisa embeera z'amaizi (solid, liquid, gas) - kino ni classification of states of matter, kandi abeeshuri nibakora omurimo gw'okuhandiika n'okushuura, ekyo nikireeta scientific observation n'okutebeekanisa.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ashemereire kushwijuma omulingo omwana atungireho oburemeezi bw'eky'okureeberaho eki ekya Corporality n'Okugyeenda: Aronda nari ayoleka omuhanda gw'ebintu eby'omunda nk'omutima, amahaho, obwongo.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba aha kuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda y'omubiri. Twetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Kureeba ebinda by'omubiri - Eki nikigamba aha kureeba ebicweka by'omubiri, tikiri aha kuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda.

B. Omwana atoore ekicweka ky'omubiri - Eki nikigamba aha kutoora ekicweka kimwe, tikiri aha kuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda bingi.

C. Kuta omubaanzi gw'ebicweka by'omubiri aha kishushani - Eki nikigamba aha kuta omubaanzi (puzzle) gw'ebicweka by'omubiri aha kishushani. Eki nikireeta abaana kuronda ebicweka by'omunda (omutima, amahaho, obwongo) n'okubiteeka aha kishushani, ekyo nikyo kwoleka omuhanda gwaabyo.

D. Kureeba vidiyo - Eki nikigamba aha kureeba vidiyo, tikiri omurimo gw'abaana kuronda n'okwoleka.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisingire omu kutunga ekigyendererwa ky'okuronda n'okwoleka ebintu eby'omunda ni:

**C**

Ninkuteekateeka ekibuuzo eki:

Abaana nibateka etabaaza omu izooba (omu bushana) kureeba ekirikubaho. Enyima y'ekyo, nibakora okuteebereza kandi nibabishushaniisa omu katarabo.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba aha nkyukakyuka y'embeera y'ekintu egi abaana barikubaasa kureeba:

- Etabaaza erikutekwa omu izooba (omu bushana/obushushu)
- Abaana nibareeba ekirikubaho
- Enyima nibakora okuteebereza kandi nibabishushaniisa

Omu etabaaza erikutekwa omu izooba, obushushu nibugutwaramu etabaaza **okuhinduka** - okushaana/okwehisa. Etabaaza erikuba solid (ekikomeire) niryehisa/rishaana rikaba amazi (liquid).

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa owa pulayimale asoma yombeka omutwe ogurikugira ngu "Okuteekateeka nk'omuhangaika." Abaana bakagira omutwaro omunungi omu by'okurabamu nk'okukora engeyeso n'okwega ebikwatiraine n'omuringo gw'abahangaika. Obwomeezi obu barikwega n'okwetegyereza n'okucumita.

Ekibuuzo: Kiki ekirikubaasisa kuteeraniza obwomeezi obu omu baana?

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

A. Ekipe ey'okukoresa omuntu kwetegyereza, okuhandiika ebintu bisya ebyegamiirwe omu kucwekyereza, reero okucweekereza.

B. Eky'okukuratira, kworeka ebiteekateeko by'okubanza n'okwetegyereza kw'okugezesa, hanyuma ogeranise data erikukurwa enyima

C. **Ekitabo ky'okutebeekanisa** - ekirikukora nk'omugufu gw'entebeekanisa n'ebiteekateeko by'okubanza eby'okucwekyereza, reero obwomeezi nibukurikiranwa.

D. Ebikoresho by'okukorakorana n'okwetegyereza ebirikworobiya n'okukiriza okucuurura omuhanda ogurikwetegyerezebwa, kwonka kugaragaza ebyahurirwe.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **C** - Ekitabo ky'okutebeekanisa kibaasa kuteeraniza obwomeezi bw'abaana omu kwega kwabo, kubanga kirikukora nk'omugufu gw'entebeekanisa n'ebiteekateeko byabo by'okubanza, kandi obwomeezi nibukurikiranwa.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akoreire aha mugasho gw'okwegyesa ogurikugira ngu "Kukoragana omu mbeera za butoosha, omu bikorwa ebirikugumaho omu kukuza eby'obutonde oburikugumaho." Yaagabana n'abaana ebikorwa by'okwegyera (kureeba vidiyo, kukora empapura, kutaayaayira esente za risaikulingi, n'ebindi). Hanyuma, aine kwetegyereza omugasho ogu yaatooranize.

Ekibuuzo: Nkoreki omuringo gw'okwetegyereza guraabe gubwire kukoresa okumanyisa oku omugasho ogu gwatiinisiibwe?

Nkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A. Kureeba ebikorwa abaana barikukora omu bwire obutungiire (okuzimya amateeka g'amaizi, okutorora empapura)

B. Kurobereza ebirango, kurugiira omu ku kondooza eby'abaana obwo barikuteeraho omutima n'obwo barikuhurira orugano orurikukwata aha bikorwa ebirikugumya obutonde

C. Kurata omu kuchekiresti yaaba abaana nibashobora kwetantaza aha bishushani by'emikoro erikukwasa n'emikoro etaarikukwasa omu butonde (okukoresa ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omurundi gwa kabiri, okuta amataka omu byondo)

D. Kungyeera amakuru omu rurembo rw'okucweekereza orurikukoresibwa kucweekereza ebi abaana barikugamba n'ebiteekateeko byabo obwo barikureeba vidiyo

Eky'okugarukamu ekirungi ni:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa akwenda abeeshuri bakurate ekigyendererwa: "Kwetegyereza Eiragiiriro ry'ebiragiro 3 omu bikorwa ebirikukwatwaho" (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle).

Omweeshuri yahandiikire:
1. Kukoresa obukoore bw'okwetantaza oburikweshamba
2. Kubyara ebimera omu byanzi by'amata
3. Kwahukanisa n'okutoorana ebyanzi ebirikwija kutaangwa omu ka

Omwegyesa akwenda kuha obuha oburikubaasa kuleetera omweeshuri "kuteeraho n'okumwebembera okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa."

Nkureeba eby'okugarukamu:

**A** - Ekubuuza aha R zoona (ebiragiro bishatu) n'ekumugamba ateekateeke muringo mushya - Eki nikimuretera kwongera okwetegereza.

**B** - Ekumugamba ahandiike amakuru g'ebiragiro bishatu n'okugarukamu ekibuuzo - Eki nikimuretera kwetegereza ebiragiro n'okubiteekamu omu magara ge.

**C** - Ekubuuza aha miringo y'okutaaho omu ishomero - Eki nikimuretera kwongera okwetegereza.

**D** - Ekubuuza ahabw'enki ebikorwa ebi birungi - Eki nikimuretera kwetegereza obukuru bw'ebiragiro.

Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyo kirungi ahabw'enki ekimugamba ateekateeke miringo y'okutaaho omu ishomero - eki nikimuretera "kuteeraho" (okukora ebikorwa ebishya) n'okumwebembera okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'abeeshuri ab'omwaka ogw'okushatu gw'amashomero ayenda kubayigiriza aha izooba (solar eclipse) n'okubakozesa kushoborra ekyo. Turikurondera omurimo oguhikire abeeshuri ab'omyaka egi.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Kukoresa orupapura n'erangi kushoborra emiterere y'eizooba - Eki kirikubaasa, nari ekitari kikomeire abeeshuri ab'omyaka egi.

**B.** Kukoresa etoroshi n'efoomu kushoborra eizooba n'okureeba ekisiizi - Eki kirikubaasa, nari ekitari kikomeire kushoborra emiterere y'eizooba.

**C.** Kukoresa akapiira akato n'ibaara kushoborra oku omumaiso gw'eizooba gurikuhinduka - Eki kirikubaasa, nari ekitari kikomeire kushoborra emiterere y'eizooba.

**D.** Kukoresa emibiri yaabo (emitwe = ensi, akabuumbo k'omweru = okwezi, akataara = eizooba) kushoborra emiterere y'eizooba - **Eki ni kihikire** kuba:
- Kikoresa emibiri y'abeeshuri (kinesthetic learning)
- Kirikubayamba kwetegereza emiterere y'eizooba omu buryo obw'obukama
- Kihikire abeeshuri ab'omyaka egi
- Kirikubakozesa kushoborra n'okukyerereza banyaabwe

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi arikwenda kucweeka obuhame bw'okucweeka aha kicweka kikuru: "Naamanya ebicweka by'omubiri gwe bimwe naayorekyezaaho arikubiranga."

Ekigyendererwa ni kumanya ebicweka by'omubiri n'okubiranga (okubiyita amazina).

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

**A.** Omwana yaizire haihi y'endorerwamu, omukuru amubuuza ebicweka by'omu maisho - Eki kirikukwata aha kumanya ebicweka by'omu maisho.

**B.** Omukuru abuuza aha bw'emitwarize n'amugambira kukwata omutwe gwe - Eki kirikukwata aha kumanya omutwe.

**C.** Omukuru arikwimba enyimba ezirikukwatana n'ebicweka by'omu maisho, arikubikoraho aha mubiri gwe wenka naareeba yaaba omwana nabigarukamu - Eki kirikureeta okwega kw'okukorana (omwana arikureeba n'okugarukamu ebikorwa), kirikukwata aha kumanya ebicweka n'okubiranga.

**D.** Omukuru naakora ebikorwa ebirikukwata aha bice by'omubiri, yaabuuza abaana kumutooreza ebikorwa - Eki kirikukwata aha kumanya ebikorwa by'ebicweka.

Eky'okugarukamu **C** ni kyonka kirikureeta okukora obuhame obw'okumanya ebicweka by'omubiri **n'okubiranga** (kwikiriza enyimba ezirikubiyita amazina) omu ngeri erikukorana.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'ekicweka kya kindergarten araganisa omu purojekiti y'eby'amagara ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurira aha kintu eki: "Kuhimba ebiteekateeko aha birikurugamu omu bintu ebirikubaho omu butonde ebi orikureeba, orikwesigamira aha bumanyi n'obuhangwa ebi waabaire nooyegaho."

Ekigyendererwa eki nikyetaaga abaana:
1. Kureeba ebintu ebirikubaho omu butonde
2. Kuhimba ebiteekateeko aha birikurugamu
3. Kwesigamira aha bumanyi n'obuhangwa ebi baabaire baayegaho

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Yolesa vidiyo - Abaana barikureeba gusa, tibakora ebiteekateeko

B. Yoreka enyanja omu kacupa - Omwegyesa niwe arikugyema tsunami, abaana barikureeba gusa

C. **Mureke abaana bakore orusozi rw'omuriro** - Abaana nibarikukora (bakora orusozi), nibareeba ekirikubaho (okuturika), kandi nibahimba ebiteekateeko (nibashoboorora eki baareebire)

D. Tebeekanisa oruziga - Omwegyesa niwe arikwihirira omutingito, abaana barikureeba gusa

Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyokukira kwasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa, ahabwokuba abaana nibarikukora n'okureeba eky'okureeberaho, kandi nibahimba ebiteekateeko aha birikurugamu.

**C**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa nakoze okugezesa "Enjura y'Emihogo" omu kugamba aha nkyukakyuuka ez'ebintu ebirikugattwa n'ebirikushaanwa omu mazi. Antonio, omwe aha baana, nagarukamu ati "Ninkunda emihogo ei orikweteraho" - ekyo kirikugarukamu aha by'obwengye/eby'okusiima, tikirikugarukamu aha mugingo gw'okwega ogw'obwomeezi.

Omwegyesa arikwenda kumugarukamu omu buryo oburikumukonera kutuura aha mugingo gw'okwega (okwetegyereza nkyukakyuuka ez'ebintu ebirikugattwa n'ebirikushaanwa omu mazi).

Ninkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A - Nikusiima, nanye kumugarukira aha by'obwengye, kandi hanyima kumugarukira aha by'obwomeezi
B - Nikusiima emibala, kandi kumubuuza aha by'obwomeezi (ebipooli)
C - Nikusiima emiringo, kandi kumubuuza okugarukamu aha by'obwomeezi (okureeba enjura omu amauta n'omu maizi)
D - Nikusiima, nanye kumugarukira aha by'obwengye

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukira ni **C** - ahabwokuba kirikusiima Antonio, nanye kirikumugarukira omu buryo ogurikumukonera kwetegyereza aha by'obwomeezi by'okugezesa (okureeba enjura omu amauta n'omu maizi - ekirikukwatiraine n'omugingo gw'okwega).

**C**

Ninkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza ngu orugero orurikukurataho oru omwegyesa arikwija kugambaho niruragana na "cytoskeleton" (omugogo gw'omunda y'ekisero).

Cytoskeleton ni muundo gw'obusaasi oguri omunda y'ekisero ogurikuha ekisero obushushani bwakyo, ogurikukikuuma kiteebeekaine, kandi ogurikukonyera omu kuhinduka kw'ekisero n'okweyongera.

Ninkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Ekyeruro ekihindura ebintu - Eki kirikukurataho enzymes/reactors, si cytoskeleton

B. Omukura ogurikukonyera obutebeekane kugumaho omunda y'eifaakitore - EKI nikyaragana n'omurimo gwa cytoskeleton - kukuuma obutebeekane n'obushushani

C. Ekicweka ky'okugenzesa - Eki kirikukurataho nucleus, si cytoskeleton

D. Ekyeruro ekishobora kuteeraho akarembo - Eki kirikukurataho mitochondria rundi chloroplast, si cytoskeleton

Eky'okugarukamu ekikwatiraine ni **B** - omukura (framework/structure) ogurikukonyera obutebeekane kugumaho, nk'oku cytoskeleton erikukuuma obushushani n'obutebeekane bw'ekisero.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda abeeshuli kwetegyereza osmosis (omuringo gw'okutwara amaizi ogutiine maani). Abeeshuli baine oburemeezi bw'okwetegyereza oku mukoro ogu. Omwegyesa ayenda omurimo ogubaasa kwongyera aha kwetegyereza kwabo.

Nkwetegyereza ebigaruzo:

**A.** Kucumuura ebitakuli omu maizi g'omunyu 0.9%, kupima oburemu enyima y'eminute 15 - Eki kirikworeka osmosis omu butonde bw'ebitakuli.

**B.** Kucumuura ekyaayi omu maizi amaruru n'omu maizi g'okushushu - Eki kirikworeka diffusion/okutwara kw'ekyaayi, tikyerekera osmosis.

**C.** Kwijuuza ebeka n'amaizi otaatseho obwojo - Eki kirikworeka semi-permeable membrane n'osmosis omu butonde.

**D.** Ekyombo kirimu ebicweka bibiri eby'ahukaniisiibwe oruhu rw'akacwamu, omunyu omu kimwe, oburabe ngu obureingwa bw'amaizi buhinduka - Eki kirikworeka osmosis omu buranga obwereire, abeeshuli barikubaasa kureeba enjyendaho y'amaizi kurugiirira omu semi-permeable membrane.

Eky'okugarukamu **D** ni kyo kirungi kurushaho kuba kirikworeka osmosis omu buranga obwereire, n'abeeshuli barikubaasa kureeba ekirikubaho (amaizi garikutwara kurugiirira omu kicweka kirimu omunyu).

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'ekyomunaana ari kutebeekaniza isomo aha miterere y'obuzimbe bw'obutofaali (cells) oburikukora ebindi, kandi yabaasa kwenda abegyesi kukwataganya okukura kw'omugasho kw'enkumbu y'omunda y'obutofaali (organelles) n'omurimo gwayo.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni enki aha bikorwa by'okwegyesa ebiija kureetera abegyesi kukurira aha kigyendererwa eki (okukwataganya structure n'omurimo)?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Yolesa ebifaananyi - kumanya omurimo gwa buri kimwe
B. Baha kubashushani aha microphotograph - obishoboorore omuhanda gw'okwiha ebintu
C. Reeta ekishushani ky'akashagama k'omubiri ekirikukora ebintu by'omunda n'ekindi ky'enyama - bagaragura omulingo ebintu ebirikubihweraana
D. Reeta ekishushani ky'akash cell ekirikukora eby'okuhisha n'ekindi - bashoborore omugasho gw'obwo bush cell kurugiira aha miteerere yaabyo

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **D** - kubanga kireetera abegyesi okushoborora (explain/relate) omugasho (function) kurugiira aha miteerere (structure), ekyo nikyo kukwataganya structure n'omurimo.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa abuuza: "Oburamuby'omubiri obwa prokaryotic nibushobora bute kwegabura?"

Ekibuuzo eki nikyetaaga enshoboroza erikworeka omulingo gw'okwegabura kw'oburamuby'omubiri obwa prokaryotic omu mulingo ogurikwetegerezebwa kandi ogurikugira obuhame bw'ebirikukwataho.

Nkareeba ebigaruzo:

A. Nikyogyera aha kutazaara - tikiri enshoboroza y'omulingo gw'okwegabura

B. Nikyogyera aha DNA - tikiri enshoboroza nzaire y'omulingo gw'okwegabura

C. Nikyogyera aha "okugabura orubaju" - eki tikiri kituufu kuba prokaryotes tizina orubaju

D. Nikyogyera aha "binary fission" - ogu gwe mulingo gw'okutuufu ogw'okwegabura kw'oburamuby'omubiri obwa prokaryotic. Nikyogyera ngu DNA egikopiibwa hanyuma obuziba bugatenganwa, nibuzaara obutundu bubiri obulinganaine.

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha omugano gwa Dalton ogw'ebintu by'omunda. Omugano gwa Dalton gukwatiraine n'emisingye y'ebintu by'omunda, okukira aha:

- Ebintu by'omunda birikukozibwa n'ebipande ebitari bibaasa kwahukanyizibwa (atoms)
- Omu kwegaita kw'ebintu by'omunda, ebipande ebi birikukwatana omu mipimo erikugarukamu (omu mihendo y'obwingi obukuru)

Ekigyendererwa ni "kushoboorora emisingye y'omugano gwa Dalton." Ninkwetaba eky'okugarukamu ekirikwoleka abegi bakore ekintu ekirikwoleka emisingye egi.

Ninkwetaba ebirikurugamu:

A. Kukora ebintu by'emishororongo ya kemikali - eki kirikwoleka ngu ebintu birikukwatana omu mipimo erikugarukamu
B. Kurikira omuhendo gw'obwingi bw'obutini - eki kirikukwatiraine n'obwingi obukuru
C. Kurikiriza omubuzo gw'ebipimo by'oburemerezi - eki kirikwoleka ngu omu kwegaita, oburemerezi bw'ebintu ebirikwegaitamu burikugarukamu
D. Kurikiriza kubara oburemerezi omu mitwaro eshatu - eki tikiri kukwatiraine n'omugano gwa Dalton

Eky'okugarukamu ekirungi ni:

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda kumanya yaaba abegyeswa bategeire **omugasho gw'ebintu ebirukora eby'okurya** (the function/role of parts that make up food/plants in a food chain context).

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Yijuza ekishushani ky'ekimera, orageze ebintu ebi kikiraganisa n'ebi kirukukora - Eki kirikworeka **obushushani n'omurimo** gw'ebintu by'ekimera

B. Ha eby'okureeberaho by'ebintu ebirukora ebyokurya byabyo byenyine - Eki kirikuha examples zokka

C. Ebirugaaba omuhanda gw'ebyomeeri gwaabaasa kukurugamu omu byomeeri bw'emiti - Eki kirikugamba aha process zokka

D. Shuuruura omukago hagati y'ebintu ebiramu ebiri omu mutego gw'ebyokurya - Eki kirikugamba aha relationships omu food web

Ekibuuzo kirikugamba aha **omugasho/omurimo** (function) gw'ebintu. Eky'okugarukamu **A** kirikworeka ngu omwana arikurageza ebintu by'ekimera n'**omurimo gwabyo** (what each part does), ekyo nikyo kirikworeka okutegera omugasho gwabyo.

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya aija kugamba aha kutebeekanisa eby'okushobora n'abegyeswa be omu itendekyero erikukwata aha bintu ebirikutunguura okukora kw'ebimera eby'okurya (photosynthesis). Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni kikuru ki aha bikorwa ebi omwegyesa arikukora ekirikubaasa kureetera eki ekigyendererwa kuhikiirira?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Kugamba aha maani g'ekyanga hamwe n'ebyo twarikwenda kumanya - eki kirikukwata aha kutandika kwega

B. Teeka omuringo gw'okukora okushomesa omuti gukaba gukwesherezibwa omu mishana etari emwe n'emwe - eki kirikukwata aha kukora okunoonyereza n'okushobora

C. Kugamba aha obururu n'obushuushu n'omufuunjo - eki kirikukwata aha variables

D. Kuha ekibuuzo ky'okushwijuma - eki kirikukwata aha hypothesis n'okutorana

Okukwata aha "kutebeekanisa eby'okushobora" (planificar experiencias), ekigarukamu ekikuru ni:

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya ari kukora aha mugenzo gwa Darwin ogw'okuhinduka kw'ebintu. Ekigyendererwa ni kureetera abegi kwetegyereza ngu **ebiriisa ebirikukwatana munonga omu kuhinduka kw'ebintu byabaire nibigabana izooba rimwe ery'enyima**.

Abegi abamwe tibarikwetegyereza eki ekirikugambwaho. Turikubaaza ni murimo ki ogubaasa kubareetera kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki.

Nkwetegereza ebigaruzo:

A. Taata ebiramu kurugiirira aha kufaanana kwabyo omu mbeera y'omubiri - Eki kirikukwatiraine n'okureeba obufaanani bw'omubiri

B. Garukamu ebibuuzo kurugiirira aha kucweekereza ekicweka ky'ekikoni kya cladogramu - Cladogramu nikyorekyesa obunywani bw'ebiriisa n'eby'okugabana izooba rimwe

C. Yomba ekishushani kirikugaburamu eby'okureeberaho by'ebishagiro - Eki kirikukwatiraine n'ebishagiro

D. Geranisiriza emikorogo ey'ebihimba ebiheraine - Eki kirikukwatiraine n'ebitarikuumirweyo

Ekigaruzo **B** nikyorekyesa munonga okukwatiraine n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza ngu ebiriisa ebirikukwatana byagabana izooba rimwe, kuba cladogramu nikyorekyesa obunywani bw'ebiriisa n'eby'okugabana bazeire.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'ina owa siniya atebeekaniize isomo eriragira abegyereza kumanya omugasho gw'okugemba omu by'obushaho bw'abantu boona. Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni ekihi omu bikorwa ebi ekirikwija kugasira omwegyesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'omukurrikuru w'eby'okwegyesa aha kumanya ebimanyiso bya sayansi?

Nkwetegereza eky'okugarukamu kyona:

A. Nibarikiriza ebirikuruga omu kugemwa kurugiirira aha byahandiikwa by'okugezesa nk'eky'omuntu nk'Edward Jenner - Eki nikireeba aha byafayo by'abantu abakuru omu sayansi.

B. Nibashwijuma obwingi bw'endwaara ezirikwata kandi bakashoboorora ebiri kubireeta - Eki nikireeba aha ndwaara zenyini, tari aha mugasho gw'okugemba.

C. Nibarikiriza omuhendo gw'abantu abahaire oburinzi n'okuguhuura n'okugaruka kw'endwara ezimu - Eki nikireeba aha MUGASHO gw'okugemba omu bushaho bw'abantu (oburinzi, okuguhuura endwara).

D. Nibakora omurongo gw'ebiro by'okukura kw'ebintu bikuru ebirikukwata aha kugemeesa - Eki nikireeba aha byafayo, tari aha mugasho.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikuragira kumanya OMUGASHO gw'okugemba omu by'obushaho bw'abantu ni:

**C**

Ninkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omweeshure yaagira ngu "akahu kyakuura kandi omuringo gwa luteinizing hormone gweyongyera, nikirekururwa kuruga omu igi kandi nikireka kureeta estrogen. Hanyuma, ekintu ekiihyaka nikireebeka omu igi erikwetwa corpus luteum..."

Ekibuuzo nikigamba ngu kiki ekirikuzibuura okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi?

Ninkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A - Nikugamba ngu okubura kw'omwe aha mishangwa y'omu nda y'abakazi nikwo kureetera okuhwa kw'amagi (Eki tikiri kituufu - amagi tikagwa, nigarekurwa)

B - Nikugamba ngu okurekurwa kw'amagi tikurikugenderera aha bungi bw'emishonga ya gonadotropic (Eki tikiri kituufu - LH hormone nayo ya gonadotropic kandi nayo erikureetera okurekurwa kw'amagi)

C - Nikugamba ngu omweeshure yatahooye omukago ogutahikire ahagati y'ebicweka by'omutindo gw'okukura kw'amagi n'emibazi ya gonadotropic ehindura omutindo ogwo (Eki nikituufu - omweeshure yaagira ngu "akahu kyakuura" ariko tiyashoboorora ngu ni LH hormone erikureetera okukura kw'akahu/follicle)

D - Nikugamba ngu corpus luteum guriho gwenyine omu ibumba ry'omwisho (Eki tikiri kituufu - corpus luteum guriho omu ibumba ry'okubiri rw'omuzingo)

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya naija kutebeekaniza okushomesa okw'okubanza okw'okugyenda omu maisho kw'ebirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza omukago oguli hagati y'omulingo gw'okukora eby'okulya kw'ebimera n'omuringo gw'okuhuumura kw'obutonde bw'ebiramu obuto".

Ekibuuzo nikyebuza: Ni murimo ki ogurikwija kumworeka okugyenda omu maisho kw'okushomesa oku?

Nkwetegereza ebyokugarukamu:

A. Ekicweka ky'okugyeragyeranisa ent differences - Eki kirikwetegereza aha njawukano
B. Empandiika ey'okusomesa - Eki kirikuha obumanyisi bw'omukago
C. Ekipande ekiine emigyeko - Eki kirikworeka okwesigama kw'emiringo
D. Ekishushani ky'ebizimbe - Eki kirikworeka ebintu ebikuru

Ekibuuzo kirikubuuza aha "okugyenda omu maisho kw'okushomesa" - ekyo nikyo learning objective/goal. Ekyokugarukamu ekisinga okworeka ngu omwegyesa agondire ekigyendererwa eki ni **C** - ekipande ekiine emigyeko y'ebirikukorwa omubaireho okwesigama kw'emiringo egi nikwo kuraangwa, kuba kirikworeka omukago (relationship) hagati y'emiringo egi.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki:

Ekibuuzo kibuuza aha kamanyiso k'eby'okushomesa akarikupimwa omu kibuuzo eky'omwegyesa aha fludarabine (omubazi oguremesa DNA primase).

Ekibuuzo ky'omwegyesa kibuuza: "Ekicweka ki ky'okweyongyera kw'obwingi bwa DNA eki fludarabine erikukwataho butoosha?"

DNA primase ni enzayimu erikukora RNA primer (ekikorwa ky'okubanza) ekirikubanzaaho okweyongyera kwa DNA. Ku fludarabine eremesa DNA primase, ekyo kirikukwataho ekicweka ky'okukora RNA primer.

Eky'okugarukamu A kirikugamba: "Shobora ekikorwa ky'omusaizi ekirikukwatanisa n'okukora RNA erikukoresibwa omu kubanza kw'okukora DNA"

Ekyo nikyo kirikukurataho DNA primase n'omurimo gwayo.

**A**

# Okwetegereza Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kirikubuuza omuringo murungi gw'okukora ogurikwongyera aha etaabulo y'omugabo ogurikworeka obunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba, kandi gukikora aha kiragiro ky'okwegyesa omu muringo ogurikuhikire.

## Okwetegereza Ebigarukamu:

**A.** Tebeekanisa ebirimu omu mw'etaafeeri omuri taabulo kuruga omu buceeri bukuru - Eki kirikukurataho okutebeekanisa ebintu omu muringo gw'obunene bwabyo.

**B.** Shutama omugazi gw'Ensi nk'ekipimo ekikuru omu meza, oreebeireho orukurato orundi orurikworeka omugano hagati y'omugazi gw'ebintu by'omu iguru ebirikushushana n'ogw'Ensi - Eki kirikukurataho okukora omugano gw'obunene.

**C.** Ngyenda ki erikukira enyakasheeshe yaitu obunene? Eky'okugarukamu: Engyenda ya Jupiter - Eki kirikukurataho okubaza ekibuuzo ky'okumanya.

**D.** Omugasho gw'okuhandiika n'omubazi gw'amaani (Scientific Notation) - Eki kirikukurataho okwegyesa omuringo gw'okuhandiika emigano mirungi munonga omu muringo gw'amaani.

## Okusalawo:

Empandiika eriho erikukurataho omubazi gw'amaani (scientific notation), kandi ekibuuzo kirikubuuza omuringo ogurikuhikire okwongyera aha etaabulo. Ahabw'okuba obunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba ni mirungi munonga, omubazi gw'amaani ni muringo murungi gw'okwombeka emigano egi.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'abiri omu sekenda ari kutebeekanisa amasomo g'ekicweka kya Kinematics (omuringo gw'amaani). Naija kukora omurimo oguraagyezaho ebiri omu isomo, kurikukiriza aha bw'amaani oburi omu kalikula aha Mutindo gwa Saayansi.

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Oruhe orurikukiriza omu bwengye aha bw'amaani obwo oburi omu kalikula?

Nkureeba eky'okugarukamu kyona:

A. Okukora omurimo gw'amaani g'omugyegye omu kucumura ebizibu bya buri izooba
B. Okushoboorora omuringo gw'amaani g'omugyegyo omu byafaayo by'abantu
C. Okushoboorora okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa n'omuringo kw'obuhangwa obw'okupima omugabo gw'amaani
D. Okushoborra omugyenzo gw'okugwa omu mwanya gw'obusheesho n'oku gyesigamire aha bwangu bw'amaani

Kinematics nikicweka ekirikukwatiraine n'omuringo gw'amaani (motion), bwangu (velocity), n'okugwa (falling objects). Eky'okugarukamu D nikyo kirikukwatiraine n'ekicweka kya Kinematics - omugyenzo gw'okugwa, bwangu bw'amaani.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza aha "ekiganisa" (limitation/problema) ky'okushushanisa amashanyarazi n'amaizi omu kwegyesa abegyesa.

Nkareeba ebigaruzo:

A. Tirikukora kukoresa ebikunizo by'amashanyarazi ebihingaanire - Eki tikiri ekiganisa ky'okushushanisa, kuba okushushanisa n'amaizi kikozesibwa kwegyesa concept, tikiri replacement y'ebikunizo.

B. Nikikugyema abegyesa kwikiriza ngu amashanyarazi "gabaasa kushura omutambi kwonka gutarikubaasa kwambuka" - Eki kikiri ekiganisa ky'okushushanisa, kuba amaizi gabaasa kushura kwonka amashanyarazi garikubaasa "kwambuka" (omu capacitors n'ebindi).

C. Tirikwikiriza abegyesa kukwataganya amagezi g'okuzibira omugendo gw'amashanyarazi n'ekintu kyona ekirikureebwa omu mugendo gw'amaizi - Eki tikiri ekiganisa ekikuru.

D. Nikikuratiiza abegyesa okuteekateeka ngu amaani g'omuringo nigushushana n'omuguta gw'amaizi - Eki kikiri ekiganisa, kuba voltage (amaani g'omuringo) tikiri exactly nk'omuguta gw'amaizi; okushushanisa oku kikozesibwa simplification kwonka kikiri na limitations.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikushushana n'ekiganisa ekikuru ky'okushushanisa oku:

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki. Omwegyesa arikugambira omwegi aha mishushano y'obushangwa n'ey'amazima ey'ekijiiko, kandi omwegi tarikutegeera obushushani. Omwegyesa arikwetaaga kugarukamu omu muhanda ogurikwetegyereza kandi ogurikuha obuhikire bw'ebirikukirayo.

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Arikugambira aha mishushano y'ekijiiko - ogurikwetenga (obushangwa) n'ogurikukwenda ahansi (amazima)

B. Arikugambira aha kuhindurana kw'ebishushani - kuruga ahaiguru okuhika ahansi

C. Arikugambira aha ndorerwamu - ebifananyi by'obushangwa biri enyima, n'eby'amazima biri omu maisho g'endorerwamu

D. Arikugambira aha kibanza ky'obushuba - obushangwa kikoleka omu kibanza ky'omuriro, amazima omu kworekwa kw'emisiri

Eky'okugarukamu **C** nikyo kirikwetegyereza obuhikire kandi kirikuha obuhikire bw'ebirikukirayo - kirikugambira omu bwetegyerezi ngu ebifananyi by'obushangwa nibireebeka enyima y'endorerwamu, obu eby'amazima nibireebeka omu maisho g'endorerwamu kandi nibishobora kworekwa aha kikoomi.

**C**

# Okwetegyereza Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza aha bumanyi abanyeshuri ab'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu mashomero ga siniya abaine kuba barikumanya **kare** kubaasa kwetegyereza ebintu ebirikukwata aha mishana nk'okwerorera n'okucwekyera kw'omushana.

## Okwetooranisa Ebigaruzo:

**A. Okumanya ngu omushana nigwenda omu murongo ogugororokire**
- Eki ni bumanyi obukuru oburikukwata aha nzira y'omushana, kandi ni bwomeezi obukuru bw'okutandikira.

**B. Okumanya ngu leza eriha omushana gw'ebara rimwe**
- Eki ni bumanyi obukuru kandi bworora oburikukwata aha mishana.

**C. Okwetegyereza omushana nk'omuyaga gw'amasannyalaze n'obushoboorozi**
- Eki ni bumanyi obukuru oburikwetaaga okumanya ebintu by'obwomeezi obw'ahaiguru (fizikisi).

**D. Okwetegyereza emiringo y'omushana nk'omuyaga n'ekintu**
- Eki ni bumanyi obw'omusingi oburikukwata aha mishana - okumanya ngu omushana ni kintu (ekirikuboneka) kandi ni muyaga (gurikukora).

Ahabw'abanyeshuri ab'omwaka ogw'okubanza, bumanyi obw'omusingi obukuru ni **okwetegyereza omushana nk'ekintu kandi nk'omuyaga** - eki ni singi y'okutandikira okwega aha mishana.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesi w'omwaka ogw'abiri omu Physics arikwenda kwegyesa aha kigyendererwa: "Kwetegyereza amateeka ga Newton n'okugakoresa kushoboorora embeera eza buri izooba."

Turikwenda kumenya ni enshonga ki aha zirikukurugiraho ezirikworeka enyikiriza ez'obushuba ibiri ezirikubaasa kutaataagura omwegyeso gw'ekigyendererwa eki.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Obureiyo n'obuhinduko bw'omwanya nibimanyisa ekintu kimwe (KIRI KIHIKIRE); amaani agurikukoresibwa kutaata ekintu nigashuuruurwa oburemeezi bw'ekintu ekyo (KIRI KIHIKIRE - F=ma).

**B.** Omubiri gwabaire nigumire, tihariho maani agurikora (SIBUHIKIRE - Newton's 1st law: omubiri gumire rundi gurikweyongyera n'obwangu obutagira buhinduko obutoosha amaani agakorera aho gumire rundi gurikweyongyera); okuhutaana nikubaho obutoosha omu muhanda gumwe n'okugyeenda (SIBUHIKIRE).

**C.** Omwanya gw'ekintu nigushobora kushobororwa kuraba omu buraayo bwagyenda kuruga aharikutaandikira (KIRI KIHIKIRE); ebintu ebiriho byonka nibishobora kukoresa amaani (SIBUHIKIRE - n'ebintu ebitariho nibishobora kukoresa amaani).

**D.** Obuhabuzi buri buriire niburemesa okweyongyera omuhanda (SIBUHIKIRE - obuhabuzi niburemesa okweyongyera); amaani agaakoresibwe ekintu ekito aha kikuru munonga nigo mato okukira amaani ag'okugarukana ag'ekikuru aha kito (SIBUHIKIRE - Newton's 3rd law: amaani ni galingana).

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikyerekana enyikiriza ibiri ez'obushuba ezirikutaataagura omwegyeso.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omu mwaka ogw'abiri ogw'ahaiguru ari kukora ekikoreso ky'okushimira ekigyendererwa: "Kwoleka ngu nibetegyereza ngu okumanya ebiri omu bwengye nikuhinduka kandi nikweyongyera hamwe n'obuhame obusya."

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni kiratwa ki ky'okushima ekirikukwata aha kwega kw'abanyeshuri aha kigyendererwa eki?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Shoborora omuhanda ogu bw'ensi yoona - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya omu bwengye bw'ensi

B. Shoborora omuringo ebintu by'omu bwengyerero byabaireho - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya omu bwengye

C. Geragyeranisa emigisha n'obugufu bw'emiringo etari emwe - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya

D. Shisha ebitebyo ebyakozirwe ekitebe ky'okushoborora - Eki kikwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya ebikwatiraine n'eizoba n'omushana

Ekigyendererwa kikwata aha "okumanya ebiri omu bwengye nikuhinduka kandi nikweyongyera." Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukwata aha kweyongyera kw'okumanya omu bwengye bw'obwomeezi ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'abiri owa siniya aija kukora okukebera okw'okubanza kw'okwetegereza kw'abeeshuri aha mbeera y'okugwa kw'ebintu. Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Murimo ki gw'okushishooreza oguraagira omwegyesa kutunga obuhame oburungi aha kumanya kw'abeeshuri okw'okubanza aha mutwe ogu?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Okuta obuntu omu iguru n'okugyeragyeranisa - Eki nikishishooreza kandi nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza

B. Okuzamu bibuuzo n'okuteerereza obwire - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza okw'okwetegereza

C. Okurikira omu kishushani oburyo omupiira guri kwihuta - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza

D. Okukora omumapu y'ebiteekateeko n'ebiragiro bya kinemaatika - Eki nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza

Okukebera okw'okubanza (diagnostic assessment) nikugamba okumanya eki abeeshuri barikumanya mbere y'okwegyesa. Eky'okushishooreza ekirungi nikyo ekireeta abeeshuri kukora ekintu ekishishooreza ekireeta obuhame obw'okubanza.

Eky'okugarukamu **A** nikyo kirungi - okuta ebintu omu iguru n'okugyeragyeranisa nikishishooreza kandi nikireeta obuhame obw'okubanza aha eki abeeshuri barikumanya aha mbeera y'okugwa kw'ebintu.

**A**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa naakora okushomesa kw'okuhameza okwegyesa kw'abanyeshuri aha ihangaanwa ry'omuguruko (Doppler effect). Omunyeshuri naagarukamu ati omushohori gw'okusaasaara kw'amaizi niguhinduka ahabw'okuba nigyesigamira aha muringo n'obureingwa bw'omugisha.

Enshobi y'omunyeshuri ni ngu areeba ngu omushohori (wavelength) gw'amaizi niguhinduka omu Doppler effect. Omu mazima, omu Doppler effect, omushohori tiguhinduka - ekihinduka ni frequency (omuringo) n'obureingwa oburikureebwa.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni:

**D** - Ekigambira omunyeshuri ngu omushohori gw'omuvumo tiguhinduka, kwonka ekihinduka ni omuringo n'obureingwa. Ekibuuzo kikamugamba okuteekateeka erireetera omuringo gw'omuvumo kugyezaho.

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'omwaka ogwa kabiri omu somero erishemereire ari kutebeekaniza isomo eririmu ekigyendererwa: "Okumanya obukuru bw'emiterere ya R nari S omu bizibo ebikoresibwa omu magara ga buri izooba"

Ekigyendererwa eki kirikwetaagisa abegyirizibwa:
- Kumanya OBUKURU (importance/significance) 
- Bw'emiterere ya R na S
- Omu bizibo ebikoresibwa omu magara ga buri izooba (everyday life applications)

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Kutebeekaniza aha makuru g'obushuuru - Eki tikihikiriize kubanga kirikwetaagisa kumanya obukuru/significance, ti kumanya bushuuru bwonka

B. Kucuubaaza aha migisha y'okukoresa emibazi - Eki tikihikiriize kubanga kirikwetaagisa kumanya obukuru, ti migisha yonka

C. Kugaragura enshonga ezirikushushana n'ezitatushana omu miterere y'ebintu - EKI KIHIKIRIIZE kubanga:
   - Kirikureeta ebintu 5 ebikoresibwa buriijo (everyday applications)
   - Kirikureeta eky'okureeberaho (ibuprofen - medicine used daily)
   - Kirikureeta okugaragura enshonga/differences omu properties - eki kirikworeka OBUKURU

D. Kukoresa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog - Eki kirikwetaagisa technical skills, ti kumanya obukuru

**C**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa ayenda kworeka abegi aha mitwarize y'ekikoroidi kugarukamu okutari kumanya kw'omwegi. Turikubaasa omugisha **ogurikubaasa kwikiriza** - ogwo nikwo kugamba omugisha ogurikubaasa kukozesibwa omu kwikiriza/okworekera.

Ninkwetegyereza ebigarukamu:

A. Koresa omugisha gwa Tyndall - ogu nikwo mugisha ogurikumanyisa ebikoroidi (omusana gukuratira omu kikoroidi, gurikuboneka)

B. Gatangye mayoneesi n'amaizi - ogu nikwo mugisha gw'okworekera/okwikiriza ogurikubaasa kukozesibwa omu klassi

C. Yashushani omuhendo - ogu nikwo kugamba ebikozesibwe honka, tari okwikiriza

D. Shisha omuringo gw'omukago - ogu nikwo kugamba theory/molecular level, tari okwikiriza ogurikuboneka

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire nikyo **B** - kubanga mayoneesi nikye kikoroidi ekimanyirwe (emulsion), kandi okugitangya n'amaizi nikwo mugisha gw'okwikiriza ogurikubaasa kukozesibwa omu klassi okworekera mitwarize y'ekikoroidi.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa atunga ekizibu: abegyesa tibarikwetegyereza ahabwenki baine kuteekamu obugumi bw'ekyoma omu namba z'abaroma omu mbeera zimwechonka (omu Stock nomenclature).

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Kuhandika ebishubo bya meto n'okubara embeera y'okusaazibwa - Eki tikiri kukurataho aha kizibu ky'obugumi bw'ekyoma omu namba z'abaroma.

**B.** Kuhandika aha kaadi metal oxides, abegyesa bakuta eiziina, bwanyima bagarukamu: "Ahabw'enki metal oxides ezirikwatanisa ezirikwombekwa zineiziina ryaazo ririhendaine?" - Eki kirikubaasa kubafunisa kwetegyereza ahabwenki obugumi bw'ekyoma burikuhenduka, ekyo nikyo kizibu kyabo.

**C.** Kuhandika copper dioxide na copper monoxide, bagarukamu ekibuuzo aha enshonga y'okubahukanisa - Eki kirikubaasa kubafunisa kwetegyereza ngu ekyoma kimwe kirikubaasa kuba n'obugumi obutari bumwe.

**D.** Kuhandika ebyoma n'amaani gaabyo ag'okwegatta, bagarukamu ahabwenki ebyoma ebimu birukubaasa kwegatta n'oxygen omu bwingi obutari bumwe - Eki kirikubaasa kubafunisa kwetegyereza ngu ekyoma kimwe kirikubaasa kuba n'obugumi obutari bumwe.

Eky'okugarukamu **C** kirikubaasa kukomaliza ekizibu ahabwenki kirikubaasa kubafunisa okureeba omu kigereranyo ekikwatiraine (copper) ngu ekyoma kimwe kirikubaasa kuba n'obugumi obutari bumwe, ekyo nikyo kizibu kyabo.

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'eshomo ry'ahaiguru erya kabiri arikwenda kukora n'abaana aha **bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura n'omugasho gwabyo**. Ekigyendererwa ni **okwikiriza ebyo esomo erikutsindika aha kumanya ebintu bya saayansi**.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A. Okukunkumura n'okubumbura eccupa ya soda** - Eki kirikworeka enkyukakyuka y'ekintu (gas erikuva omu soda) kandi abaana barikubaasa kukireeba n'okukikora. Kiri kya saayansi kandi kirikworeka bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura.

**B. Okucereeza ebimera eby'omu maizi** - Eki kirikukurata aha kumera kw'ebimera, tari aha bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura.

**C. Okureeba entaano erikuhinduka amajeru** - Eki kirikworeka enkyukakyuka y'obwengye (solid to liquid) - bushobozi bw'ekintu kwenyunyuura. Abaana barikubaasa kukireeba n'okukikora.

**D. Okureeba kashushani k'oxyhemoglobin** - Eki kikakamavu munonga kw'abaana b'eshomo ry'ahaiguru erya kabiri, kandi tari kya hands-on.

Eky'okugarukamu **A** n'**C** byombi birikworeka enkyukakyuka z'ebintu, ariko **C** ni kyangu munonga kw'abaana b'eshomo ry'ahaiguru erya kabiri kandi kirikworeka bwereere enkyukakyuka y'obwengye (solid to liquid).

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa owa secondary (mwaka ogwa kana) ateeraho ekigyendererwa: "Huura aha muganano gw'obwingi n'omugyenzo gw'ekibaro okubara pH omu mishonga etari y'amaani eya asidi na baze ez'emiringo etari emwe."

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Okumanya ki okurikukurira okukuru abeeshuri kwakaba bamaze kutunga kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki?

Nkwetegereza ebigarukamu:

A. Omukago gw'amaani g'omushongi n'omusingi ogwaagwo ogurikugwaamu - Eki nikigamba aha muganano hagati y'amaani g'asidi/baze n'omusingi ogwaagwo (concentration)

B. Okwoikirira kw'eky'etantaro ky'ebintu ebirimu obusobozi bw'amaisho - Eki nikigamba aha indicators

C. Okugambira aha muhendo gw'okuhinduka kw'ebintu - Eki nikigamba aha conservation of mass

D. Okuteekateeka omubuzo gw'amaanyi g'ebirikiso - Eki nikigamba aha solubility

Ekigyendererwa nikigamba aha "muganano gw'obwingi n'omugyenzo gw'ekibaro okubara pH" - eki nikigamba aha relationship hagati y'obwingi (concentration) na pH value.

Kubaasa kumanya omuganano ogwo, abeeshuri nibateekwa kumanya ngu pH iri related na concentration y'asidi oba baze.

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukuratira ni:

**A**

Kureeba ekibuuzo eki, omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa abegi kushoboorora ebintu ebirikugumya obuziizi bw'atomu.

Ebintu ebirikugumya obuziizi bw'atomu ni:
- Protons (ebirikugumya charge y'obusinguzi)
- Neutrons (ebitaine charge)
- Electrons (ebirikugumya charge y'obukwatsi)

Kuba abegi basobore kushoboorora ebintu ebi, nibateekwa kumanya:
- Namba y'obuto (atomic number) - erikworeka omubazi gw'ama-protons
- Omubazi gw'enzitoyo (mass number) - erikworeka omubazi gw'ama-protons n'ama-neutrons hamwe

Kuba abegi bamanya namba y'obuto n'omubazi gw'enzitoyo, nibasobora kushoboorora:
- Protons = namba y'obuto
- Neutrons = omubazi gw'enzitoyo - namba y'obuto
- Electrons = protons (omu atomu erikutaine charge)

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**C**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omurimo gurikugyenderera aha mugasho gw'okwega: "Kushoborora ebintu ebirimu obutonde bw'ebyomubiri kuraba omu mitwe yaabyo egirikukora"

Ekibuuzo nikiraba: Ni kihi ekitarikuhikaana n'ekigyendererwa kandi tikishemereire kuba kimwe aha birikugyendererwa omu kubaza omurimo ogu?

Nkareeba ebigaruzo:

A. Kumanya ebirango by'emikora - Eki kirikukwatana n'okushoborora ebintu
B. Orikushora ebintu ebirikukora omu muringo ogurikushushana - Eki kirikukwatana n'okushoborora
C. Orikushora ebintu ebirikukwatana omuhanda gw'okushushana kw'emiterere yabyo - Eki kirikukwatana n'okushoborora
D. Kutegyeka ebintu by'obutonde bw'ensi ebirikushushana orikukoresa amagara g'okutebyeka IUPAC - Eki nikyokushushana kw'ebintu by'obutonde bw'ensi (chemistry nomenclature), tikiri aha kushoborora ebintu kuraba omu mitwe yaabyo egirikukora

Eky'okugarukamu ni:

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki. Omwegyesa ari kukora aha mutwe gw'ebyaara n'amaani n'abaana ab'omumwaka gwa munaana. Ekigyendererwa ky'omukozi gw'okugezesa ni kworeka ngu obwingi bw'ebyaara oburikukwatwa nibwisigamira aha bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano obwa buri kintu.

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Okareesha obuzito obuhinguraine bw'amaizi na giriseri - Eki kirikukwatiraine n'obuzito obuhinguraine, ti bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano.

B. Amaizi omu bikopo bibiri ebiringaanire (ndiba na bwaafu) - Eki kirikworeka ngu ebintu ebitari bimwe birikukwata ebyaara omu ngeri ezitari zimwe, ekirikukurataho bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano.

C. Amaizi agyezire na amaizi g'omunyo - Eki kirikukwatiraine n'obushuushu bw'okuteera, ti bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano.

D. Ekijiko ky'ekyuma omu kikopo ky'amaizi - Eki kirikworeka okuhinduka kw'obushuushu, ti bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano.

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **B** - kirikworeka ngu ebintu ebitari bimwe (ndiba na bwaafu) biine obushobozi obuhinguraine obw'okukwata ebyaara, ekirikukurataho bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano obwa buri kintu.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa arikutebeekanisa eishomo ry'okukoragana n'abanyeshuri ab'omumwaka gwa munaana aha mugingo ogurikukurataho: "Kutaho ebintu ebirikugyendererwa n'ebitarikugyendererwa omu bintu ebirikukwata aha kuhingura amata"

Omugingo gw'eishomo ni aha "kutaho" (okwawukanisa) ebintu ebirikugyendererwa n'ebitarikugyendererwa omu kuhingura amata. Ekyo kirikuragira okwawukanisa ebintu ebiine omugasho n'ebitaine omugasho omu mbeera y'okuhingura amata.

Nkureeba ebigaruzo:

A. Aha kwerarikana n'okurwaire sukaari - Ekyo tikurikukwata aha kuhingura amata
B. Aha omugisha gw'okunywa omwenge - Ekyo tikurikukwata aha kuhingura amata

Eky'okugarukamu kirungi nikyo **D** - ebipooli omu soda bireeberaho bwangu omukago gw'obushuushu n'obwinganiza bw'empeho omu mbeera ya buri izooba.

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omugurusi akozire okucungura aha atomu n'okubumbwa kw'emishuro. Abanyeshuri nibaikiriza ngu okubumbwa kw'emishuro ya cationi nikubaho ahabw'okuba atomu neyongyera "netunga" protoni (ekibi). Omurimo ki ogubaasa kushohora abanyeshuri kuteeraho kuteegyereza omuhanda murungi?

Nkwetegereza eky'okugarukamu kyona:

**C** - Kukora ekishushani ky'ebiteekateeko - Eki nikishohora abanyeshuri kureeba ebiteekateeko byona, naabwo tikyetegereza aha nkomerero y'okubumbwa kw'ayoni.

**D** - Kugaragura omukago oguri ahagati y'akatomu ka sodiumi etarikwetantara n'emitwarize ya sodiumi nk'ayoni - Eki nikishohora abanyeshuri kureeba omugaragaro omutanduko, kandi nibareeba ngu omuhendo gwa protoni gurikubaho nk'oku gwabaire, naabwo erekituroni nizo ezihweire.

Eky'okugarukamu **D** nikishohora abanyeshuri kureeba omugaragaro omutanduko n'okuteeraho kuteegyereza ngu cationi nikubumbwa ahabw'okuhwera erekituroni, ti ahabw'okwongyera protoni.

B. Ahabw'emirimo ya B na T lymphocytes - Eki ni kintu kya buri kiragiro
C. Ahagati n'okugumisiriza hamu n'okwijukya kw'omubiri ogw'amaani gwaasiima kurwana n'endwaara - EKI nikyo kirikukwatiraine n'omuringo ogwa kashatu - okwijukya n'okugumisiriza
D. Ahari aha kwikiriza endwara n'okutarikwikiriza endwara - Eki ni kintu kya buri kiragiro

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikukwatiraine n'omuringo ogw'okutangira ogwa kashatu ni **okwijukya** n'**okugumisiriza** kw'omubiri.

Omwegyesa arikwegyesa aha masannyalaze n'arikwenda kumanya obuhikizi bw'ekigyendererwa: "Okwetantaza ebintu ebirikukwata amasannyalaze kuruga omu bintu ebitarikukwata amasannyalaze"

A. Kureeba omuringo gw'amasannyalaze gurikukora n'ogutarikukora - Eki kirikukwata aha kumanya oburyo omuringo gw'amasannyalaze bwogukora, tari aha kwetantaza ebintu ebirikukwata amasannyalaze n'ebitarikukwata.

B. Noonyereza aha misisa mikuru eyabaho - Eki ni kunoonyereza aha by'abaire bibaho, tari kutaanisa embeera ezikozesebwa kushoboorora

D. Shoborora enshuranuro eri ahagati y'omutaano gw'oburemeezi bubiri ogukurataireho aha kipimo kya Richter - **EKI ni kutaanisa embeera (omutaano gw'oburemeezi) ezikozesebwa kushoboorora ekyanyaikani (omu kipimo kya Richter)**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo eki. Omwegyesa abuuza abegi be: "Kuba ekirikutaabura ebiramu n'amajoro omu DNA yaabyo, shi omugasho gw'okugaragurira hamwe endinganisa z'amino asidi omu protein niki?"

- Omugasho gw'okugaragurira amino acids omu kushoborra okuhinduka

**C** - Erikwogera aha RNA n'okukora protiini, n'empinduka omu rukurato.

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikyo kirikugarukamu ekibuuzo ky'omwegyesa omu buryo obweshoboozi, kuba kirikwogera omu buryo obweshoboozi aha engingo y'okugaragurira amino acids n'okumanya okuhikirana kw'ebika omu by'okuhinduka.

**B** - Erikugamba aha orwoote n'akagyeenura akataine mirimo erikumanywa

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikwetegyereza ngu ahabwenki oburo bw'omukazi bukoresibwa ni **D** - ahabw'okuba orwofaafa orw'ekitima ky'eggi ry'omukazi rwine ebintu byona ebirikwetagisa okuhindura obuto obutari bumwe n'okureeta embeera y'omwana kukura.

Omwegyesa abuuza: "Nikimanyisa ki ngu okushomesa oburwanisi bw'endwara ya virusi kwoleka ngu IgG eriyo kandi IgM teriyo?"

Nkwetegyereza amazima g'obushoboorozi bw'emibiri erwanisa endwara (antibodies):

- **IgM**: Ni emibiri erwanisa endwara ey'okubanza erikureeterwa omu kicweka ekya kubanza eky'oburwaire. Egumaho obwire butonotono.

- **IgG**: Ni emibiri erwanisa endwara erikureeterwa omu kicweka eky'okubiri, egumaho obwire burikurengaaho (omu myaka), kandi ereka ngu omuntu yakaba akira rundi yakaba yakoranisibwe.

Aha mbeera ya **IgG eriyo kandi IgM teriyo**, nikimanyisa ngu:
- Omuntu takaba ali omu kicweka ekya kubanza eky'oburwaire (ahabw'okuba IgM teriyo)
- Omuntu yakaba akira rundi yakaba yakoranisibwe omu bwire obuhise (ahabw'okuba IgG eriyo kandi egumaho)

- Engeri okugabana kw'ebyanga okukwatiraine kukora
- Oku okugabana okutakwatiraine kukora ata omu kansa

- C: Ebyanga by'omutwaro - tikwatiraine n'okukura kwa kansa

B. Eky'okugarukamu kw'omubiri okurikushushana - Eki kirikushushana gusa

D. Omugisha gw'omugongo, obwongo, ebirungo by'okuhurira n'ebikorwa - Eki kirikukurataho ebitundu byona by'entebe y'obwengye

Eky'okugarukamu ekisaaniire ni **C** - kirikukurata aha biragiro by'okukuumira omugufu (conservation of momentum) omu nkora erugaire, ekiri ekigyendererwa ky'isomo.

Omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa: "Okukoresa omuringo gw'omuyaga kworeka ngu omushana nigugaruka n'okucwekyera ku gurikukwata aha muhingo ogurikwegaanisa ebintu bibiri."

C. Eky'okureeberaho omu kiraasi - omutwe gw'ekyanga (laser) nigukuba amaizi, kirikubaasika kureebwa ngu omutwe gumwe nigwegyema (reflect) ogundi nigucwekyera (refract)

D. Omuringo gw'okushushana ogurikukoresa kompyuta - gurikworeka omushana gwaba gutaire aha mpaka z'ebintu bibiri

Ekikoreso ekirikwangutsya okwetegyereza ebirimu ni ekyo ekirikubaasisa abana kureeba n'okwetegyereza omu bwomeezi bw'okucwekyera n'okugaruka kw'omushana. Eky'okureeberaho omu kiraasi ky'omutwe gw'ekyanga (C) nikyangutsya okwetegyereza ahabw'okuba abana nibabaasa kureeba omu bwomeezi reflection n'refraction nibikora.

Omugurusi areeba okutangara omu abegyesa abarikutabaasa kuhuura embeera z'amaani g'ensi (omutwe ogurugire aha muti n'omwezi ogurikwetorora ensi). Omugurusi akwenda eky'okureeberaho ekirikukuza okwetegyereza kw'abegyesa.

**A.** Omugo gw'omunyeeto - gushushana n'amaani g'omugyego omu mbeera y'Okwezi
- Eki kirikworeka amaani g'omugyego (centripetal force)

**B.** Ekishushani ky'ekikamba ekirikuguruka - kirikworeka ngu ebintu bigwa/bikirira Ensi
- Eki kirikworeka amaani g'omugyego n'obukutte bw'ensi

**C.** Omubumbi ogugwa - kirikworeka okugwa kw'ebintu n'enzira ezaakuratizibwe
- Eki kirikworeka amaani g'omugyego n'okugwa

**D.** Ekishushani ky'okugwa kw'eibuga - kirikworeka omukoranire gw'amaani hagati y'Okwezi n'Ensi
- Eki kirikworeka OMUKORANIRE gw'amaani hagati y'omwezi n'ensi - ekyo nikyo kirikuhuura embeera zombi (omutwe ogurugire aha muti = amaani g'ensi; omwezi ogurikwetorora = omukoranire gw'amaani)

Eky'okugarukamu ekirikuhuura embeera zombi ni:

Omugyezibwa w'omu secondary omu kiraasi ey'okubanza ateekanize kukora aha biteekerezo ebi birikukurataho omu mutwe gw'ebicweka n'omuranga. Ekibuuzo nikibaza ngu ni biteekerezo ki bibiri ashemereire kubanzaho kukoraho kubaasa kuteeraho ombereho omu kwega ebindi ebiri aha lukalala.

Omu kwegyesa ebya sayensi, hariho orugyendo orw'okutandikira aha biteekerezo by'omusingi (basic/fundamental concepts) okutandika kwega ebindi ebikomeezi.

- Okutetema n'omulingo - Ebi nabyo birikwetaaga okumanya ebindi ebikuru
- Amaani n'obureingwa - Amaani ni ky'omusingi, naabwo obureingwa bwetaaga okumanya amaani

Oburemu (masa) n'Amaani (fuerza) ni biteekerezo by'omusingi ebirikwetaagwa okuteeraho ombereho omu kumanya ebindi byona nk'okutetema, omulingo, okwerorera, n'ebindi.

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa w'ekibiina ky'omwaka ogw'okubanza aheesiire enteekateeka y'okukora ekizibu ky'okugyezaho aha muheru gw'eishomo erikukwata aha bintu ebirikuhurira. Turikubaaza ni birikukurataho ebikorwa by'omwegi ebirikworeka ngu bamanyire ebireetera embeera ya Doppler?

Embeera ya Doppler erikukwata aha okuhinduka kw'omuringo gw'oruyo (sound waves) rundi omugisha (light waves) omu kuhurira kw'omuntu arikutebekanisa, okusinziira aha bwangu bw'ekintu ekirikukurugyaho oruyo rundi omugisha - omu kugenda haihi rundi okwihaho.

Nkureeba ebigarukamu:

A. Erikukwata aha maizi n'omuhindo - ti embeera ya Doppler
B. Erikukwata aha kurikira omulingo oruyo rurikukora omu kuhurira - **Eki nikyo kirikworeka embeera ya Doppler** - okuhinduka kw'omuringo oruyo omu kuhurira okusinziira aha bwangu bw'ekintu
C. Erikukwata aha omutindo gw'okwehindura - ti embeera ya Doppler
D. Erikukwata aha enshonga y'omururu - ti embeera ya Doppler

**B**

Ninkwetegyereza ekibuuzo eki:

Omwegyesa owa secondary ari kutebeekaniza okushwijuma okwaheru kw'ekicweka ky'okwetegyereza eby'okuhindurana bya oxidation-reduction (redox). Ekigyendererwa ni: "Kwetegyereza eby'okuhindurana bya redox omu magara ga buri izooba n'omugasho gwabyo omu bantu b'omuri obu bwire".

Ninkwetegyereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

A. Kwangirika kw'ebintu by'ebyoma ahabw'enkuba erimu asidi - Eki ni ky'okuhindurana kya redox omu magara ga buri izooba

B. Embeera z'omulingo gw'okutangaaza ogw'ebintu by'omwiijo - Eki tikiri ky'okuhindurana kya redox

C. Okuhindura ekikopo ky'emiyoboro y'amaizi kurugiirira omuyaga gwa okisijeni - Eki ni ky'okuhindurana kya redox omu magara ga buri izooba (okutangaaza amaizi)

D. Omuhendo gw'amasannyalaze agahindurwa omu batiri - Eki ni ky'okuhindurana kya redox omu magara ga buri izooba n'omugasho gwabyo omu bantu

Ekibuuzo kirikubaza niki ekirikukwasa kwegerereza obuhame bw'okutungwa kw'ekigyendererwa. Buri ky'okugarukamu A, C, na D birikworeka eby'okuhindurana bya redox omu magara ga buri izooba. Ariko D ni kyo kirikworeka obuhame bw'omugasho omu bantu b'omuri obu bwire (batiri).

**D**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omugendererwa ni "okukora n'okushoboorora data erikukwata aha miringo y'ebintu ebiriyo omu by'omubiri n'eby'obushoboorozi bw'ebintu ebiriyo."

Nkwetegereza buri ky'okugarukamu:

**A.** Ha data aha bw'okutemba kw'amazzi - abaana bahabwa data eyakabaire erongoirwe, tibakora data yabo benene.

**B.** Bacuubaaze aha bw'okureenga kw'amazzi - abaana nibakora obucuubazo bwabo benene (okukora data), kandi nibashuuruure/nitebeekanise emitwarize (okushoboorora data). Kino nikukwatiraine n'emiringo y'ebintu (hydrocarbon ebirimu obureingwa obutari bumwe) n'eby'obushoboorozi bwabyo (omu mbeera erikushushana).

**C.** Ha data aha bw'okutemba - nayo abaana bahabwa data eyakabaire erongoirwe.

**D.** Ha data aha bw'okutenta - nayo abaana bahabwa data eyakabaire erongoirwe.

Eky'okugarukamu **B** nikyo kyonka ekiha abaana omukisa gw'okukora data yabo benene (okucuubaaza/okukora obucuubazo) n'okugishoboorora, ekyo nikyo ekikwatiraine n'omugendererwa ogugambirweho.

**B**

Nkwetegereza ekibuuzo:

Omwegyesa akora okugyezibwa kw'okushishoora yaaba abegyendesereza nibabaasa kumanya emihinduko y'ebintu ebirikubaho omu bwengye bwabo. Omutwe gumwe gwayolesa:
- Omuhinduko gwa sodium hydroxide na hydrochloric acid
- Okureebeka kwa hydrochloric acid kuruga omu hydrogen na chlorine
- Okureebeka kwa carbon dioxide kuruga omu carbon na oxygen

Ekibuuzo nikigamba: Ni butumwa ki obu omwegyesa arakuha abegyendesereza kubahiga omu by'okwega ebirikushishoorwa?

Nkureeba ebigarukamu:

A. Ebirikuhindura omuringo bya kemikali - Ebi byona ebyayolesibwe ni emihinduko ya kemikali (chemical reactions)

B. Ebiringaanisa bya kemikali omu bintu bya buri izooba - Ebyayolesibwe byona ni bya laboratory, tiri bya buri izooba

C. Miringwa eretera ebintu bya buri izooba - Ebyayolesibwe tiri bya buri izooba

D. Engyenderwaho ezirikuba zigyezibwa omu bikorwa bya buri izooba - Ebyayolesibwe tiri bya buri izooba

Ekibuuzo ky'omwegyesa kirikugamba aha kumanya emihinduko ya kemikali (chemical reactions/transformations).

**A**

Ekibuuzo kiri kukwata aha emisingi y'ekicweka kya Bernoulli.

Ekicweka kya Bernoulli kikwatiraine n'okutembera kw'amazi (fluid dynamics) kandi kikwata aha nkwaano eri omusingi gw'okugumiisiriza energy omu by'omwika ebirikwenda (fluids in motion). Ekicweka kino kikwata aha pressure, velocity, n'elevation omu fluid erikutembera.

Okusobora kwetegyereza ekicweka kya Bernoulli, abanyeshuri baine kumanya omusingi gw'okugumiisiriza energy - ngu energy y'omukago (kinetic energy) + energy y'okushushana (potential energy) + pressure energy = constant omu fluid erikutembera.

Eky'okugarukamu ekituufu ni:

**C**
